name: Vendoo
summary: Crosslisting app for online resellers: list an item once to eBay, Poshmark, Mercari, Depop, Etsy and more, with sale detection that delists sold items everywhere, inventory and profit tracking.
best_for: resellers listing on several marketplaces such as eBay, Poshmark, Mercari and Depop who want one inventory with automatic delisting when an item sells
skip_if: you sell on one marketplace only, or you want to try it without entering a card first
honest_knock: The free trial needs a card and turns into a paid plan on day 14, and once billed the charge is non-refundable on monthly and annual plans alike. Annual plans cannot be changed until the cycle ends. Starter includes no background removals, and automatic offers and marketplace sharing for Poshmark, Depop and Grailed are only on the $49.99-$59.99 Pro plan. UK visitors get a different, item-capped plan set in pounds. We have not used Vendoo ourselves.

pricing.notes: (read 2026-10-08 on vendoo.co/pricing from a US connection, USD, with both the monthly and the yearly toggle) Vendoo sells three self-serve plans for resellers. Starter is $14.99 a month billed monthly or $12.49 a month billed yearly: unlimited items, all marketplaces, sale detection and auto-delisting, listing templates, importing, delist and relist, analytics and the iOS and Android app, with no PhotoRoom background removals. Growth is $29.99 monthly or $24.99 a month yearly and adds AI listing enhancement, bulk actions on up to 240 listings at once and up to 300 PhotoRoom background removals. Pro is $59.99 monthly or $49.99 a month yearly and adds automatic send offers on 6+ marketplaces, marketplace sharing on Poshmark, Depop and Grailed, up to 1,500 background removals and listing videos; the yearly Pro card also lists premium support and live call support. Enterprise, for businesses creating more than 1,000 new listings a month, is priced by sales. The yearly toggle says up to 2 months free. The comparison table lists crossposting to 10+ marketplaces and sale detection and auto-delisting for Poshmark, eBay, Mercari, Depop, Whatnot and Etsy. The FAQ says the 14-day free trial requires a valid payment method and the subscription starts automatically on day 14; once billed, monthly and annual charges are non-refundable, annual plans cannot be changed until the end of the cycle, and state sales tax is added where required. From a Netherlands connection the same URL redirects to vendoo.co/uk/pricing, a different model priced in pounds by new items per month: Free £0 for 5 items, Simple £16.99 a month for 125, Plus £27.99 for 250 and Pro £49.99 for 600, with 6 marketplaces.

compare_with.name: Koongo
compare_with.why: Koongo is in our dossiers too, but it syncs a Shopify store's product feed, stock and orders to marketplaces such as Amazon and eBay; Vendoo is built for resellers listing individual items across resale marketplaces like Poshmark, Mercari and Depop, with sale detection to delist sold items.
